Payroll run — —

Unpaid days come from the weights on the Policy tab. Per-day rate is monthly gross divided by the divisor, and the deduction is capped so it can never exceed gross. Click a row to open that employee's month.

Policy

What the engine does with these

Load a report

Drop a PDF performance report, or a CSV / XLSX punch export, and it is parsed in this page — nothing is uploaded anywhere. A PDF is read exactly the way the bundled extractor reads it: values at their printed coordinates, then reconciled against the report's own summary row. Loaded months are added to the picker at the top right.

Drop a file here or PDF · CSV · XLSX · XLS

Loaded months

Loading a month that is already here replaces it — the newest file for a month is always the one in force, whatever it is called. Remove a month and its calendar, corrections and payroll leave with it.

reports you load are kept in this browser only, never sent anywhere

Source & reconciliation

The app never re-types a figure. Every daily value is read out of the PDF, and the check below re-adds those daily values and compares them to the report's own printed summary row. All rows must read OK — that is the proof the extraction is exact.

Files

Rule engine runs client-side · every figure derived from the report, nothing hard-coded —
